senses.gloss: ch. same, to fine, punish. Y. B. Kam. VIII, end, 6ᶜ וקַנְסֵיה ליטר דדהב he fined him one litra of gold. Bab.
units: <cite ref="Bava Kamma 30b:10">B. Kam. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>לאלתר קַנְסִינָן וכ׳</he> do we fine him (decree the forfeiture of the material deposited in the street) at once, or when he derives the intended benefit? <cite ref="Shabbat 3b:4">Sabb. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>מי קַנְסוּהָ רבנן לאהדורי וכ׳</he> do the Rabbis punish him by forbidding him to withdraw his hand? <cite ref="Shabbat 3b:11">Ib.</cite> <he>בשוגג לא קנסוה וכ׳</he> if he did it by mistake, the Rabbis do not punish him.
<cite ref="Shabbat 3b:8">Ib.</cite> <he>ליקנסוה רבנן</he> let the Rabbis punish him (by forbidding him to withdraw his hand)!; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 72a:6">B. Mets. 72ᵃ</cite> <he>קנסינן התירא וכ׳</he> we decree the forfeiture of the legitimate claim (the principal) on account of the illegitimate (the interest; a. e.).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 15:25">Targ. Y. I Ex. XV, 25</cite> <he>דמְקַנְסֵּי</he> (not <he>דמִקְנְסֵי</he>).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Numbers 35:25">Targ. Y. Num. XXXV, 25</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 32:50">Targ. Y. I Deut. XXXII, 50</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 21:22">Targ. Y. Ex. XXI, 22</cite> <he>מתקנסא יתקנס וולדא</he> the lost embryo must be paid for according to assessment (h. text <he>ענוש יענש</he>).
